description: This file defines an Android activity (`Layers`) that demonstrates usage of Canvas layers with alpha in custom drawing. It includes an inner class `SampleView` which handles drawing on a Canvas by drawing two overlapping circles with transparency within a saveLayerAlpha block.

classes.name: Layers
classes.description: An Android Activity that sets up a custom view to demonstrate layered drawing with transparency.

classes.name: SampleView
classes.description: A custom View subclass that performs drawing of overlapping circles with alpha blending.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity and sets the content view to an instance of SampleView.

methods.name: SampleView
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the Paint object and sets focusability.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Performs the drawing of background and circles with transparency on the Canvas.
